verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents private status pages for internal teams, protected by SSO, password, or IP restriction. It also documents email subscriptions to a whole status page or to selected components, so stakeholders could follow incidents without joining the war room. However, the subscription feature is described for customers, and the evidence never confirms that it works on private internal pages or describes how structured incident updates are written. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that subscriptions work on private/internal status pages, documentation of structured incident-update authoring and its format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, internal stakeholders get structured incident updates they can subscribe to, without joining the war room

citations.quote: Create a private status page for internal teams or enterprise customers.
Have full control over who sees what.
Let your customers subscribe to e-mail updates removing the need to reach out to you individually.
Let your customers subscribe to the entire status page or just selected components.
